assessment.nobel_worthiness: Leptin provided a decisive molecular and endocrine framework for physiological control of body weight and appetite.
assessment.attribution: The candidate presents Friedman as the singular credited discoverer of this central advance.
assessment.maturity: The finding has had decades of experimental and clinical influence and its physiological importance is firmly established.
uncertainties: The extent to which therapeutic impact beyond rare leptin-deficiency states should weigh in evaluating the discovery is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a fundamental signaling system by which cells sense and adapt to endoplasmic-reticulum stress.
assessment.attribution: Mori and Walter represent complementary foundational contributions to defining the pathway and its signaling logic.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism is deeply established across cell biology, physiology, and disease research.
uncertainties: The broad, multi-investigator development of the field makes precise allocation of the three-person limit consequential.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding transformed understanding of how proteins attain functional structure in cells.
assessment.attribution: Horwich and Hartl are appropriately paired for the central conceptual and mechanistic advances represented by the candidate.
assessment.maturity: The discovery is longstanding, repeatedly corroborated, and foundational to modern molecular cell biology.
uncertainties: Protein-folding research encompasses related contributions outside the specifically defined chaperonin discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Recognition of distinct B- and T-cell lineages created a durable organizing principle for adaptive immunity.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are the two credited contributors to the complementary lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The distinction has been validated over many decades and underlies basic and clinical immunology.
uncertainties: The lineage framework emerged through a wider sequence of immunological work, complicating sharp boundaries of credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade converted a pathogenic cytokine insight into a transformative treatment paradigm for inflammatory disease.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini are credited for linking the biological hypothesis to decisive therapeutic development.
assessment.maturity: Its clinical benefits, mechanism, and broad adoption have been established over a long period.
uncertainties: TNF biology and anti-TNF therapeutic development involved substantial contributions from additional investigators and organizations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition demonstrated that a genetically defined cancer driver could be targeted with remarkable clinical effect.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio covers kinase-inhibitor development and the clinical and biological validation of targeted treatment in CML.
assessment.maturity: The paradigm has endured and influenced cancer medicine far beyond the original disease.
uncertainties: Attribution must distinguish this particular therapeutic success from the wider discovery of BCR-ABL and subsequent drug-development efforts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA in maternal blood enabled a major shift toward noninvasive prenatal genetic screening.
assessment.attribution: Lo is the sole credited name for the core discovery in this candidate.
assessment.maturity: The technology has achieved extensive clinical implementation and its diagnostic value is well established.
uncertainties: The appropriate balance between recognizing the biological discovery and later assay and implementation advances remains uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and its translation into incretin therapeutics have substantially changed treatment of diabetes and obesity.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker represent key physiological, molecular, and translational dimensions of the credited discovery.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy and broad medical impact are compelling, although the field continues to evolve rapidly.
uncertainties: The candidate lists four credited contributors, requiring a difficult exclusion under the three-person limit.
The relative credit for foundational physiology, drug design, and clinical translation requires careful further assessment.
